title: One setting picks the platform's design system (DAWN or Frequency), every design-owned value is replaceable, and Frequency switches the older theme layers off

source.ref: ADR-1737. Owner 2026-10-13: the only two themes for the main site are DAWN and Frequency, a one-button change-over; the new Frequency theme will override everything; Midnight will become a theme for users; make sure the local installation is fully themeable.

detail:
lib/theme/design.ts (DesignId, SITE_DESIGN from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_DESIGN, LEGACY_THEME_AXES, browser chrome per design); app/layout.tsx stamps data-design statically and loads app/themes/frequency.css (scoped scaffold); app/globals.css adds the design layer (--design-radius-*, --design-shadow-*, --design-font-*, --design-map-*) and @theme inline reads it; lib/theme/server/resolve.ts, app/(main)/layout.tsx, components/spaces/accent-scope.tsx, the Settings switcher and Theme Studio honour LEGACY_THEME_AXES; Midnight is selectable and scoped by SkinDef.designs; lib/maps/css-color.ts feeds the three MapLibre maps; ?design= previews tokens locally. lib/theme/design.test.ts holds the sheet contract.

Shipped 2026-10-13. Frequency's values arrive with its design system export.
